title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Fubuki Azuma's Arc 3
content: When the break time ended, Yuki was led to the garden of the Azuma household by Himari.
There stood Toka, alone, in a powerful stance.
"Since you’ve come to train in the Azuma household, I’ll train both you and Himari together."
"What a wonderful opportunity."
First, Himari, if you want to copy my ability, start by reading the flow of life energy.
Try absorbing the life energy from the flowers blooming there.
"…What does that mean?"
"Yes, it’s an old method. I was disappointed when I couldn’t absorb it back then."
When Kamairika heard that Himari's ability was copying, she had been delighted.
If she could copy and somewhat use others' abilities, it would be an excellent quality for someone from the East.
Immediately, Kamairika ordered Himari to try using her ability.
However, Himari could only copy a tiny fraction of Kamairika's ability.
Even when trying to absorb life energy from the flowers, she could only manage a minimal amount, enough to make the flowers slightly wilt.
The same applied to copying other abilities; it was far from being at a practical level.
"I still dream about that disappointed look I had back then."
"Then try to succeed this time and overwrite that nightmare."
"Fine, I’ll do it!"
"That spirit is good. But the key is the result."
Himari faced the flowers with a serious expression and raised her hand.
If you think about absorbing it, you won’t be able to do it well.
Feel the life energy the flowers possess and imagine scooping it up.
"In the past, I didn’t quite understand even when told that. But now, after training in the 7th Squad…"
Himari concentrated on her ability.
The flowers remained beautifully bloomed.
"Well, it’s not an ability you can master in an instant. Try it for a while."
Kamairika said this and then playfully slapped Himari’s rear before turning to Yuki.
"Now, what shall I train you in, kid?"
"I want to become stronger."
"What a straightforward gaze. Alright, I’ll make you a fine man."
Since Himari was currently testing Kamairika's ability, Yuki couldn’t be turned into his slave form.
Yuki had to train in his physical body.
"Now then, let’s have you take off your clothes."
"If that’s necessary to become stronger, then I will."
"Just kidding, just kidding."
Saying this, Kamairika enveloped her body in a golden aura.
This is the surge of life energy.
I can burn this stored life energy like an engine to enhance myself.
I’ll use this to train you.
With that, Kamairika lunged at Yuki.
"Show me how you can deflect my attacks! I won’t accept any whining about being in your physical body."
Yuki, having guarded against Kamairika's fist, was blown away.
As he bled from his nose, he was astonished by the impact.
"If you take it head-on, that’s what happens. You need to be resourceful."
Unforgiving strikes assaulted Yuki.
He desperately tried to respond, but still got blown away.
Intense pain struck him.
However, he couldn’t afford to complain.
When things got tough, the face of his master, Kyouka, floated in Yuki’s mind.
If he made a sound, his master would laugh at having such a pathetic slave.
Of course, he wanted to become stronger, but he couldn’t give up here for his master’s sake.
No matter how much he was beaten, Yuki stood up and faced Kamairika.
Kamairika's movements were novel to Yuki, and he understood well that this was a good experience for him.
Eventually, Yuki found it wasn’t as difficult to stand up as he had thought.
"How about that? Even if you think your body can’t move anymore, you’re actually doing quite well."
Kamairika hugged the battered Yuki as if to encourage him.
"Kamairika-san?"
"If I keep this up, you’ll die. Let me heal you."
Then Yuki’s body was enveloped in light and began to heal.
"You’re all better now."
Yuki tried moving his body and found no pain anywhere.
"It’s perfectly healed."
"Isn’t it amazing? I’m the former squad leader."
It seemed that during this time, Kamairika had given some advice to Himari.
"Now that you’re healed, shall we have another round of training?"
"What will it be? Is it tough to continue? Or do you want to stop?"
"Please, let’s continue!"
"Hehehe. They say there are particularly spineless men these days, but you’re quite something."
Kamairika relentlessly continued to strike Yuki.
"I did it!"
The flower she targeted had wilted.
When Himari finished absorbing the life energy from the flower, Yuki was receiving his third healing.
"Oh, you managed to absorb it. Well done, Himari!"
Kamairika laughed exuberantly and rushed over to Himari.
It took too long, but the fact that you absorbed it until the flower wilted is a good sign.
With training, you might be able to use my ability to some extent.
"I did it, I did it!"
"Yes, I’m glad as a member of the East!"
Kamairika sincerely praised Himari.
Now, Wakura Yuki.
I’ve released quite a bit of life energy.
From now on, I’ll teach Himari the tricks while replenishing my own life energy.
I can only handle you up to this point.
"Thank you for your guidance."
"Now, Himari, it’s time for focused instruction."
"That’s just fine."
"Hmmm, hmmm."
"What’s with that staring at my face?"
"I can’t believe the expression you have now compared to when you were constantly losing back then, Himari."
"I’ve been thoroughly trained in the 7th Squad."
"Fuhaha. I suppose I should thank Uzen Kyouka for training you."
"It’s not just about training the body; she teaches about having a dignified heart as well."
"Since you’re a disciple of Riu, that’s to be expected."
"Anyway, our captain is amazing. Make sure to get along with her as a member of the East."
"Yes, I will."
Yuki watched with a smile as Himari received various advice from Kamairika.
Indeed, it was best for families to get along well.
After thanking Kamairika once more, Yuki left the scene.
Once again, Yuki found himself with free hands.
(In such a big house, I wonder if there are professionals for housework?)
He glanced around the Azuma household.
It was thoroughly cleaned from corner to corner.
Naturally, his curiosity about the kitchen was part of his love for housework.
Yuki asked Yachiho, who happened to pass by, about the Azuma household's kitchen.
"If you’re curious, you should take a look. I’ll guide you."
"Thank you, I appreciate it."
"Heh. You give off an air that makes you seem like someone who can’t be left alone."
"You have a reliable aura, Yachiho-san."
Yuki, who loved his older sister, and Yachiho, who adored her younger sister, seemed to have a good wavelength or compatibility.
"Himari is currently training with Kamairika-san."
Yes, I know, as I’ve been watching from the shadows.
If Himari can use not only my ability but also Kamairika-sama’s ability a little, she’ll be a fine member of the East.
She’ll be able to come home proudly!
Yachiho genuinely celebrated her sister's growth.
"There was a time when Himari used to sulk while hitting this pillar, look, this scar."
"It’s still clearly visible."
"I told her not to fix the pillar, so it’s been left like that."
As they proceeded toward the kitchen, a delightful aroma wafted through the air.
"This way is the kitchen. If anyone asks, just say you got permission from me."
Yachiho only guided him and then headed off to continue her training.
When Yuki peeked into the kitchen, a surprising sight unfolded before him.
"Oh, are you hungry?"
Fubuki was cooking in the kitchen.
"Fubuki-san, you can cook too?"
"I can when I have the time. Usually, there's someone responsible for housework."
"That's amazing, especially since you're so busy."
"I hope you like it, considering you're a pro at housework."
"With a smell like this, it has to be delicious. I can tell."
"Hehe, that's right."
"Um, is there anything I can help with?"
"Don't worry about it, just relax."
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gE4l7io.jpeg
Yuki stared at her back.
Even in her every movement, it was clear she was accustomed to cooking.
Suddenly, Yuki remembered his home.
His parents were still alive.
They had recovered from the incident of their daughter going missing during the Mato Disaster.
He thought again how he wanted to inform them of his sister's safety as soon as possible.
Before he knew it, Fubuki's face was very close.
"Huh?"
Startled, Yuki involuntarily spoke.
"You looked a bit sad just now."
"...I was thinking about home."
"You haven't gone back home since entering the Anti-Demon Corps dorm, right? Don't you feel lonely?"
"Well, I'm okay. Besides, I can go back whenever I want. It's not far from here."
"Oh, really? It's only a ten-minute bus ride from here."
"I used to play by the Tamagawa River when I was little."
"Maybe we've crossed paths somewhere before."
"If I saw someone like Fubuki-san, I definitely wouldn't forget."
Then you should come to the Azuma household more often.
You can show your face to your family too.
Make sure to go home sometimes.
Fubuki said kindly and returned to her cooking.
It was mealtime in the Azuma household.
Fubuki's cooking had a delicious yet somehow nostalgic taste.
The salmon and eggplant simmered with grated daikon and the mushroom spring rolls were especially tasty.
The highlight was the handmade kamaage udon.
"Delicious, Fubuki's udon is amazing. It's been a while since I've had it."
"With the manager of the 7th Squad here, the Azuma household has to give it their all."
Yuki was eating the udon with a surprised expression.
"It hit me right in the head. This udon is on a whole different level from what I've had before."
"I've loved this udon since I was a kid."
"Himari, should I share a little of mine with you?"
"Absolutely not! Yachiho and Homare eat too little, so you need to eat properly."
"I think it's just that Maiya and Mom eat a lot."
"Besides, Homare snacks too much."
"I want to constantly nourish my brain."
Well, eat as much as you want.
And be strong, that's the Azuma way.
Fubuki, more please.
I'm still in my growth period.
(I still don't know how to respond to that old woman's jokes.)
"Just laugh, Homare."
(Are you reading my mind? Scary.)
"Hehehe. This isn't a power, it's experience. Even in my growth period, I have a wealth of life experience."
At the lively Azuma dining table, Yuki was also making progress with his chopsticks.
"I'd like a refill too, please."
"You really liked it, I'm glad."
"Fubuki's love for udon is serious. She even went all the way to Kagawa to study it."
"You have quite the hobby, huh?"
"Nothing compares to what they make on-site. I'm still learning."
Yuki was devouring an unexpectedly large amount.
After dinner, they trained in the dojo with mental concentration training.
This was a proper lesson with a Zen master invited.
Although it was training that didn't involve physical movement, the mental fatigue was no joke.
Kyouka also had knowledge of Zen and yoga, so Yuki had been trained to some extent.
Thanks to that, he managed to keep up with this kind of training.
(...I have a bit of time before bed, but I really don't have the energy to play with anyone...)
"Oh, it's Wakura Yuki! Are you just going to sleep?"
Homare called out to him.
"Yeah, you seem energetic. Wasn't the mental training hard?"
"I'm used to it by now. It's just right. Come to my room."
"Huh?"
"Ah, I'm not going to eat you or anything, just let me gather some data."
This time, Homare pulled Yuki's hand and forcibly led him into her room.
"Don't be so tense. I'm not doing anything right now."
"Emphasizing 'right now' makes me tense."
"Hehehe. If you get scared like that, it makes me want to tease you."
Homare's room was neatly organized.
"Your room is really clean."
"Of course, it's my castle. I have to make it as comfortable as possible."
"That's impressive, especially since you're so busy."
"Himari's room is a mess, right?"
"Yeah, it's not exactly cluttered, but..."
"That's where the difference already starts."
Homare laughed heartily.
"I invited you to my room. I'll make you some coffee."
"Coffee at night?"
Don't worry, I'm tired.
I can sleep right after a little caffeine.
It actually helps relieve muscle fatigue and increases blood flow.
"I see, then I'll take some."
"It'll take a bit, so just wait."
"You really care about it, huh?"
"Good black coffee helps with data collection."
"And what data do you want to collect?"
"I'll ask you a few questions about the Slave. Just answer what you can."
"Is that to fight Himari?"
Of course, that's part of it.
But the main focus is data for when we fight together.
If we forget the Anti-Demon Corps' purpose, we won't be able to rise up.
Yuki was surprised by the serious words coming from Homare.
"My ability is pre-ordering. The more information I have in advance, the easier it is to predict the next move."
"I see, that makes sense."
As she spoke, she turned on her laptop and began typing at an incredible speed.
The shelves were lined with many difficult-looking books, and Yuki thought she might be more of a brainiac than he initially thought.
"I think most of what I know is already known."
Yuki provided data within the range that would make it easier to cooperate as part of the Anti-Demon Corps.
Don't worry about whether the data you provide is useful or not.
Your perspective is new, and I want those kinds of opinions.
Whether we utilize the data or not is our responsibility.
Since Homare was continuing to say reasonable things, Yuki's view of her changed slightly.
"By the way, I wonder how your body changes when I hold the Slave."
"Why don't you ask Himari about it?"
"I don't want to ask her. The only time I'll bow my head to her is when I'm headbutting her."
"Why are you so aggressive towards Himari?"
Because I'm from the branch family and she's from the main family.
If the main family were as monstrous as Kyouka... ahem, Ame no Mitori no Mikoto, I'd only be annoyed by her.
But she's weak yet in a privileged position, so it makes me want to attack her.
"Himari is working hard."
"It doesn't matter if you work hard if you don't get results. That's the Azuma theory."
"But the results are already..."
Yeah, I know.
She's getting results now.
So, I guess the reasons for my annoyance have changed a bit from the past.
Now it's because she's grown and gotten cocky.
That Himari, she's starting to hit back properly for the bullying she took back then.
"If you're in the 7th Squad, you'll become tougher both physically and mentally. I did too."
"Hehehe. Alright, then I'll take data on that tough body next. Strip."
"Understood."
"Wha—! You idiot, are you really going to strip?!"
Homare's face turned bright red.
"I was joking, sorry."
Yuki was already used to this kind of response from Kyouka.
"Y-you jerk! Were you teasing me? You thought I would get scared? That's... humiliating."
Since she was genuinely surprised, it made it even more humiliating for Homare.
(I managed to escape. It was a friendly atmosphere, but she's not someone to let my guard down around.)
Yuki felt relieved, but as a result, Homare would become even more attached to him than before.
